title: covidmortality
text: Overview tab allows users examine monthly COVID-19 deaths across Australia January 2020 January 2024. Use date range slider select period interest. total death count line chart automatically update reflect selected period. line chart displays monthly COVID-19 deaths, interactive tooltips providing exact number deaths month. Peaks indicate periods higher monthly death counts, declines indicate periods fewer recorded deaths. visualisation helps identify changes national mortality patterns time. Data consideration: Monthly deaths classified month occurrence. January available 2024, final year represent complete annual period.

what: Comparing mortality across states and territories
title: covidmortality
text: State & Territory tab allows users compare registered COVID-19 deaths across Australia’s eight states territories. Select year dropdown menu update total registered deaths, bar chart, geographical map. bar chart compares recorded death counts across jurisdictions, map displays geographical distribution. Hover individual bars map regions view corresponding death counts. map represents distribution recorded deaths, population-adjusted mortality rates. Larger bars darker map regions indicate higher numbers recorded deaths. visualisations help identify geographical differences registered COVID-19 mortality.

title: covidmortality
text: Additional Analysis section provides comparisons. Expand section select Change deaths two years analysis dropdown. Choose starting year ending year compare registered death counts across states territories. resulting bar chart displays absolute percentage changes hovering bar. Positive absolute changes indicate increase registered deaths. Negative absolute changesindicate decrease. Percentage changes show relative magnitude change compared starting year’s death count. starting year’s count zero, percentage change calculated displayed N/. starting ending years must different, ending year must later starting year.

title: covidmortality
text: Alternatively, select Distribution deaths across states territories analysis dropdown. Choose year view percentage distribution state territory total registered deaths. bar represents proportion national registered deaths attributed particular jurisdiction. shares across eight jurisdictions sum 100%. analysis helps compare distribution recorded deaths across jurisdictions, rather comparing absolute counts alone.

title: covidmortality
text: SEIFA tab allows users examine differences registered COVID-19 deaths across five socioeconomic disadvantage quintiles. Select year dropdown menu update total registered deaths bar chart. quintiles represent areas grouped according level socioeconomic disadvantage: Quintile 1 represents disadvantaged areas. Quintile 5 represents least disadvantaged areas. bar chart compares registered death counts across groups. Hover bars view exact counts. visualisation helps identify differences distribution recorded COVID-19 deaths across areas different levels socioeconomic disadvantage. However, higher death counts necessarily indicate higher individual mortality risk.

title: covidmortality
text: application provides several ways explore COVID-19 mortality patterns Australia, including changes time, geographical differences, socioeconomic distributions. Several considerations important interpreting results: Death counts versus mortality rates: datasets contain death counts rather population-adjusted mortality rates. Differences may partly reflect population size. Registration versus occurrence: state SEIFA datasets classify deaths year registration, whereas monthly dataset records deaths month occurrence. datasets use different time bases directly compared without considering distinction. SEIFA interpretation: SEIFA dataset classifies deaths according socioeconomic characteristics area residence. establish individual socioeconomic circumstances individual mortality risk. Data availability: monthly dataset covers January 2020 January 2024, data available January 2024. Therefore, 2024 represent complete year. ABS data also provisional may subject revision. Consequently, visualisations support exploratory comparisons recorded COVID-19 deaths establish causal relationships differences individual mortality risk.
